subject.title: [Feature]: Enable transcript-backed Codex steering after upstream idempotency

question: Should this issue remain the canonical OpenClaw tracker for transcript-backed Codex steering after upstream idempotency, independent of the broader SQLite migration PR?
rationale: The missing capability is proven, but maintainers must choose its canonical owner and sequencing across the Codex plugin, upstream protocol, and authoritative transcript storage work.

options.title: Keep independent tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open, define acceptance criteria against the landed upstream capability, and integrate with whichever authoritative transcript API is approved.

options.title: Fold into storage program
options.body: Move the requirement only if a narrower canonical storage item explicitly owns the Codex integration and preserves this upstream capability gate.

recommendation.title: Keep independent tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, define acceptance criteria against the landed upstream capability, and integrate with whichever authoritative transcript API is approved.
